title: Add Google Analytics to capture basic site metrics
body:
In addition to logs of all registered users (email addresses + confirmation of TOU/PP acceptance) and contact information for all "Get Involved" webform submissions, at the request of our funders (and for our own performance evaluation) we need to add the ability to track the following indicators. Not an exhaustive list, but these should serve as a good baseline. Other suggestions welcome. We will also need to loop in legal to ensure we appropriately communicate data tracking and usage via cookie prompts etc (cc @emcohn)

Site traffic
Unique visitors
Referrals
Registrations
Data downloads
Engagment (time spent, interactions, etc)

@calremmel @rkassa if you could do some basic investigation in the package we need and pricing (I imagine a basic GA package should suffice?) @Mougk and I can reach out to our Google leads to see if we can get credit for GA + GSuite. Thanks all!
